title: Karcher WV6 Plus Window Vac - $131.98 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ OnePass) @ Bunnings
body:
Deal: Karcher WV6 Plus Window Vac - $131.98 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ OnePass) @ Bunnings

[japes] Well, shit. Ordered one from Karcher last week at 189, although it was the full bundle.
[Matt86] Yeah I was going to do the same, but didn't need the full bundle. I only use it to quickly remove condensation from windows of a morning.
$189 for the full bundle is good!
[japes] I didn't need the full bundle either but it was cheaper than the base kit - great find on this deal.
[DashCam AKA Rolts] If you are interested, files for 3D printed wall mounts for this.
https://www.printables.com/model/340883-wall-mount-bracket-f…
[StingyShopper] I got one of these exact models from an Amazon return warehouse in Brisbane for $30.
They are definitely not worth $200. Its quicker to use a squeegee and spray bottle. Its just a small vacuum thats it.
E-waste
Edit: I actually have the "Signature" edition. Aparently worth more with a Karcher Signature on it
[Matt86] Depends on what you're using it for, I wouldn't use it to clean a window - despite that's what it's designed to do.
I use it to remove condensation from windows and pour it down the drain - Its great for that.
[StingyShopper] I suppose so, i just find it hard to justify at $200RRP. I was disappointed at $30
[Matt86] Yeah hence at $130 for a device with warranty and removes water from my house, it's decent.
[Relocate2835] How do you order from this Amazon returns warehouse in bris? Or can you go there? I think I know where it is
[StingyShopper] Bit of a hidden gem, theres two of them, one in acacia ridge and redcliffe.
Its not amazon offical but they sell return pallets and items
[morediscount] From the description:
Premium white colour
Designed and engineered in Germany
Some Group of people will really like this…
[bobbedHairKaren] haven't been to Germany lately, have you?
[MS Paint] It takes 5 minutes practice with a YouTube video to do this properly with a squeegee. FFS
[Matt86] Depends on your usage, I wouldn't buy it to clean windows.
[Runatme] I have the Bosch version of these. Regret the buy…they're not really that good or helpful at all. A bit of Windex and the Courier Mail does a better job.
[Wiadro] these are shit, i have one and i use a fresh microfibre, it cleans better
these machine leave streaks
